title: Regular bands and playing with Louis Dumaine
summary: He lists his regular bands, mentions Sidney Desvigne, and says he worked with Louis Dumaine before Sonny South.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You mentioned some band was Sales, and I've forgotten which one.

That was Sidney, Sidney Desmond. He got a 11 piece band too. Did you play with them too? You know, substitute, because you piano play. I never was a regular man in this band. But my regular band that I really played in was Sonny South Syncopators, and Creole Serenators, Willow County Rippers, and Hannes, but I called it Hannes Seekers. I worked with Louis Duhmann on several bands.
When did you work with Louis Duhmann? Oh, yeah, quite a while. That's in the 40s still, or?
When was that now? Oh man, that's quite a while. Way back. Yes, way back, yeah.
Before you played with the Sonny South?

Yeah, I think it was before I played with the Sonny South, way back. Who was in his band? Would you remember any of that? One of my cousins was trombone. Oh yeah? I used to call him Yankee. That's your cousin? Yeah, you know him. You know him? No, I heard all about him. Johnson, his name was. He's related to you? Yeah, that's my cousin. Oh yeah?
